structure.merge: Clone pre-split parent and retrain on union of the original legal training rows; never average child parameters.

calibration.method: joint group/conditional-class NLL, bounded log temperatures and centered group biases

selection.metric: number of actual executor outputs correct from OOF predictions for calibrated candidates; other candidates do not train on calibration

abstention.shared_gate: maximum cosine similarity to the original training features
abstention.threshold: 5th percentile on the V13 calibration features

include: four calibration fits plus final refit

freeze: Write SHA-256 of source files, protocol, holdout and imported V13 sources before feature extraction or training; write selection before reading new held labels for scoring.
acceptance: Report measured results without changing thresholds. Structural usefulness requires actual held route+expert outputs above the strongest admitted alternative after all cost components, not oracle improvement alone. No pass is claimed from successful execution.
